classes.name: GHud
classes.comment: HUD singleton (global 0x23f44c, TheApp d7c10); constructed size 1264 (0x4f0). Xbox vptr at +0 padded to 16, so own fields sit +0x10 above PS2 (PS2 vptr last at +0x4f4, PS2 size 0x4f8) up to +0x2ac; 4-byte PS2 bools pack on Xbox at +0x2b0 (shift becomes +4), +0x30c (0), +0x430 (-0xc), +0x454 (-0x10). The 5-slot vtable 0x19ff84 is not GHud's: it belongs to a separate 0x4c-byte RViewCamera subclass allocated in the ctor (global 0x23f450). Most of +0x24..+0x2ac are GGallery puppet handles named by their gallery strings.

fields.name: vtable
fields.evidence: ctor dab50 and ~GHud dc420 store 0x1a06c0 (1 slot: scalar deleting dtor e00d0) at +0; PS2 vptr is last (+0x4f4, written in ctor 23ae30/dtor 23c560); Xbox own fields shifted +0x10 (vptr padded to 16)

fields.name: tar
fields.evidence: ctor: FastAlloc(0x4c) + EAGL::TAR::TAR(eca20) stored +0x10; ~GHud calls TAR dtor ecab0 and frees 0x4c; PS2 +0x0 -> EAGL::TAR::~TAR. Intended type EAGL::TAR *

notes: Packet vtables: 0x1a06c0 (1 slot) is GHud's own vtable (stored at +0 by ctor dab50 and ~GHud dc420; the slot is scalar_deleting_destructor e00d0). 0x19ff84 (5 slots) is stored into a separately allocated 0x4c-byte object (FastAlloc(0x4c, tag 0x19ff78) + RViewCamera::RViewCamera 96ae0, then vtable 0x19ff84, +0x8=0) whose pointer goes to global 0x23f450; ~GHud deletes it through vtable slot 0 with arg 1. It is a HUD camera class, not a GHud member or interface.

Globals: 0x23f44c = GHud singleton (TheApp d7c10 returns it; ~GHud clears it); 0x23f448 = ActionQueue (new 0x974, ctor 4f320 with 0x1a06b8, dtor 4f1b0; Reset calls 4f280 on it); 0x23f450 = the HUD camera above.

Puppet/key/canvas fields are typed void * / UGroup *: GET_Canvas(UGroup*,char*) and GET_Gallery return gallery groups; GET_Puppet(UGroup*,char*,int,int) and GET_Key(void*,int) return untyped handles (the draw helpers take GGallery::Keys *). Retype them once GGallery puppet/Keys types exist.
Evidence rows +0x214 (-> __ftol2) and +0x1ec/+0x1f8 (-> GSystem::LOCALE_Symbol) are stray pointer hints: the ctor stores puppet handles there.
Xbox has no radar-stencil or QRadar methods (StartRadarStencil, DrawQRadar* are PS2-only) but still loads the radar puppets (+0x22c..+0x244).

Xbox +0x4..+0xf are never accessed: padding for 16-byte alignment (a 16-aligned member is presumably in +0x3c8..+0x3f4, where PS2 UpdateTargets writes 64-bit pairs at +0x3d0/+0x3f0). +0x3c8..+0x3f4, +0x4e4..+0x4ef and a number of Reset-only dwords are left undefined.
The GGallery placeholder (size 0xc0 from new(0xc0) in the ctor) exists only for the gallery pointer type.
GGallery placeholder dropped: its real layout is in cluster16.
